title: AI and the Economy: An Economic Examination of Production, Distribution, Firms, Labor, and Welfare
abstract: arXiv:2609.01263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming economic systems by altering production processes, labor markets, and the structure of firms and industries. AI is not merely a technological innovation. It is fundamentally a major economic phenomenon and a new wave of innovation with important implications for productivity, employment, market structure, public policy, long-run economic growth, and collective welfare. This essay examines the economics of AI by analyzing the multiple channels through which AI influences economic activity and societal well-being. It argues that AI should be understood simultaneously as a form of capital, a form of synthetic labor, a general-purpose technology, as well as an economic infrastructure. The analysis shows that AI functions as a multi-channel engine of productivity growth through automation, augmentation, optimization, prediction, and innovation. translated_title: 人工智能与经济：对生产、分配、企业、劳动与福利的经济学考察
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）正在通过改变生产过程、劳动力市场以及企业和产业结构，迅速变革经济体系。人工智能不仅仅是一种技术创新，它从根本上说是一个重大经济现象，也是一股新的创新浪潮，对生产率、就业、市场结构、公共政策、长期经济增长以及集体福利具有重要影响。本文通过分析人工智能影响经济活动与社会福祉的多种渠道，考察了人工智能的经济学。文章认为，应当同时将人工智能理解为一种资本形式、一种合成劳动、一种通用目的技术以及一种经济基础设施。分析表明，人工智能通过自动化、增强、优化、预测和创新，成为生产率增长的多渠道引擎。文章指出，人工智能有潜力……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从经济学视角系统考察了人工智能对生产、分配、企业、劳动与福利的影响，提出应将AI同时理解为资本、合成劳动、通用目的技术与经济基础设施，并阐明其通过自动化、增强、优化、预测和创新成为多渠道生产率增长引擎的作用。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a systematic economic examination of AI's impact on production, distribution, firms, labor, and welfare, arguing that AI should be understood simultaneously as capital, synthetic labor, a general-purpose technology, and economic infrastructure, and that it serves as a multi-channel engine of productivity growth through automation, augmentation, optimization, prediction, and innovation.
